notes: The static app server redirected index.html URLs, which broke the widget's relative script; the test therefore served the widget from a second static origin. This is a property of the local server, not of the build.
Element asks each viewer to approve a widget before its first load (and again when its URL changes); that prompt is part of Element's widget security and adds a click on first use.
Reloading the page discards session-only creator fields, as P-000018 and P-000021 Residual state.
